title: MCP Catalog: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: Curated verified servers
steps.what: Ping provides a set of curated MCP servers (support for customer-published entries alongside Ping's is on the roadmap).
steps.why: Servers found on the open internet are an unvetted supply-chain decision, and security review has nothing to base approval on.

steps.title: Registry build pipeline
steps.what: Each is built through the registry pipeline, validated end to end against a live session, and published as multi-architecture images, so a deployment is known-good before it reaches a tenant.
steps.why: Servers found on the open internet are an unvetted supply-chain decision, and security review has nothing to base approval on.
